analysis.insight_summary: A user seeks a compact, dedicated housing for [product_name] that allows access to its keypad/display or has space for an external keypad/display. Existing solutions such as mounting frames and operator devices from [company_name] are mentioned, but none provide a ready-made, installation-friendly enclosure. As a result, third-party options with custom cutouts are being considered.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [company_name] to offer a compact, purpose-built, and easy-to-install housing solution for [product_name], with straightforward access to the keypad/display or provisions for an external display.
